$Comment: A second CustomSkillAsset alongside Smithing.json, using the same Pattern A shape for a skill that is entirely station-bridge-driven (its XP arrives only through Extensions/CookingProgression.json's Target:{Action:'prepfish'} Work.Xp append; Cooking has no native jar built-in to migrate off, unlike Smithing). Display.Name has no key field by design parity with the runtime model: Messages.skillNameMsg resolves the skill.cooking lang key first (shipped in this pack's own Server/Languages/<locale>/mmoskilltree.lang), so 'Cooking' below is the raw last-resort fallback only, not the authored display text. MaxLevel is deliberately omitted, matching Smithing's own omission, so both fall through to CustomSkillsConfig.DEFAULT_MAX_LEVEL (200) unless a server owner overrides custom-skills.json.

Display.Name: Cooking
Display.Description: Prepare and cook food at work stations to gain experience
